settings.text: Composite boards come in two broad types, often called Generation 1 and Generation 2. Here’s how they differ, so you can compare like with like.
settings.footnote: Performance varies by manufacturer and board design. Always check the specification for the boards you’re buying.
settings.card1_text: Uncapped boards can suit projects where upfront cost matters most. Capped boards are worth a look if you want better surface protection, a richer finish and less upkeep.
settings.card2_text: Cladding boards are made for walls and need the right battens, ventilation, fixings and fire-performance checks. Don’t use decking boards as cladding, or cladding as decking.

settings.q: How many boards do I need?
settings.a: Every Twin Deck board is 4 m long and 140 mm wide. Use our deck planner for your area and edge length, and allow extra for gaps, cuts and waste. [CONFIRM: recommended gap between boards]

settings.q: Which side of the board do I lay facing up?
settings.a: Either. Each Twin Deck board has a different colour on each face, so you choose the look when you lay it. [CONFIRM: both faces carry the same finish and warranty]
Our SSL starters and MC03 fasteners come in boxes of 100. [ANSWER: how many per m² and spacing]

settings.q: Can I lay boards straight onto pedestals?
settings.a: No. Composite boards need a frame of compatible joists, and the frame sits on the pedestals. Only lay boards straight onto pedestals if the board maker has approved that exact set-up.

settings.q: How many pedestals will I need?
settings.a: As a first guide, allow around 6 to 7 per m² [CONFIRM FOR THE VERTEX SYSTEM]. The real number depends on your joists, pedestal grid, deck height and loading.

settings.q: What does the 10-year fade warranty cover?
settings.a: Qualifying manufacturing or material defects, subject to the warranty terms. It doesn’t cover damage from incorrect installation, poor storage or handling, misuse or neglect. [CONFIRM: what the fade warranty measures]

settings.q: Do I need to register my warranty?
settings.a: Yes. Register online with your order number and photos taken during and after installation, including the frame before the boards go on. How to register

settings.text:
Composite boards are made to look like timber while cutting out most of the upkeep that comes with it: no yearly sanding, staining or sealing.

Twin Deck is a reversible board with a different colour on each face: Eclipse with Storm, or Chestnut with Silver Oak. Every board is 4 m long, with S-MF07 L-corner trims in the same colours to finish the edges. Fix it with SSL starters and MC03 fasteners [CONFIRM FIXING METHOD].

Not sure which colour suits your space? Order samples and see them against your brickwork and planting first.
